about: Gateways and routers for the company's background work - scripts, CI, nightly jobs. Not for people: a gateway means ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, and under it Remote Control, cloud sessions, the advisor and the organisation's server-managed settings stop (code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control, /managed-settings). People keep their claude.ai sign-in and use routecall profiles for a cheap window. Licence, archive state and last push read from the GitHub API on the day below.

litellm.why: litellm 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 on PyPI carried a credential stealer (24.03.2026, about 40 minutes live, yanked); 1.83.0 is the first release from the rebuilt pipeline; 1.78.0-1.82.6 were audited clean. Check for litellm_init.pth in site-packages.

compared.name: LiteLLM
compared.kind: proxy with budgets, keys per team, guardrails (Presidio), many providers
compared.fits: the default for scripts and CI: one address, a daily budget, PII masked before it leaves

compared.name: Bifrost
compared.fits: when LiteLLM's Python proxy is the bottleneck at high request rates
compared.routecall: named; config by its own docs

compared.name: Higress
compared.kind: AI gateway on Envoy (Alibaba), with plugins
compared.fits: a company that already runs Kubernetes ingress

compared.name: RouteLLM
compared.kind: learned router: a strong or a weak model per request
compared.fits: research and offline evaluation; no push since 08.2024 - decidecall's bench is the maintained way to decide per task

compared.name: claude-code-router
compared.kind: local router in front of Claude Code, routes by task kind (background, think, long context)
compared.fits: one developer's own experiments; it is a BASE_URL too, so not for a person who needs the remote

compared.name: llama-swap
compared.kind: swaps local models on demand behind one OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible address
compared.fits: the company's own machine: one lead model kept loaded, the rest on call

compared.name: cc-proxy-plugin
compared.kind: Claude Code plugin + local proxy that routes by the model name's prefix (GLM, OpenRouter, Claude side by side)
compared.fits: mixing models in one session by model name; same BASE_URL limits

compared.name: opencodex
compared.kind: provider proxy for Codex and Claude Code
compared.fits: a Codex-first team; same BASE_URL limits
